_about: Public-domain Francis de Sales (1567-1622, Bishop of Geneva, Doctor of the Church) in English for the Word Hoard: 12 volumes from Internet Archive scans, among them the Introduction to the Devout Life (1876, 1878), Henry Benedict Mackey's Library of St. Francis de Sales (Letters, the Treatise on the Love of God, the Catholic Controversy, the Canticle, 1894-1910), the Spiritual Conferences (1862, 1909) and Miles Car's Treatise of the Love of God (Douay, 1630). Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 24 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

desales-devout-life-1876: Introduction to the Devout Life, a new translation, Library of Spiritual Works for English Catholics (London: Rivingtons, MDCCCLXXVI)
desales-devout-life-1878: An Introduction to the Devout Life, edited by Walter J. B. Richards (London: Burns & Oates, 1878)

desales-treatise-love-god: Library of St. Francis de Sales II: Treatise on the Love of God, tr. Henry Benedict Mackey, third edition (London: Burns & Oates; New York: Benziger; catalogued 1910)
desales-catholic-controversy: Library of St. Francis de Sales III: The Catholic Controversy, tr. H. B. Mackey, revised (London: Burns & Oates; New York: Benziger, 1909)
desales-letters-religion: Library of St. Francis de Sales IV: Letters to Persons in Religion, tr. H. B. Mackey, fourth edition (London: Burns & Oates; New York: Benziger, 1909)
desales-canticle: Library of St. Francis de Sales VI: Mystical Explanation of the Canticle of Canticles, tr. H. B. Mackey (London: Burns & Oates; catalogued 1908)
desales-conferences-1862: The True Spiritual Conferences of St. Francis of Sales, with a preface by Cardinal Wiseman (London: Richardson and Son, MDCCCLXII)
desales-conferences-1909: The Spiritual Conferences, translated from the Annecy text under Abbot Gasquet and Canon Mackey (London: Burns & Oates; New York: Benziger, 1909)
desales-love-of-god-lear: Of the Love of God, abridged, tr. H. L. Sidney Lear (London: Rivingtons, MDCCCLXXXVIII)
